description: A saved US shipping address of the declared storefront user (address book), created for the test and deleted at teardown; the address lines are a valid US address so the storefront address check (Loqate) accepts it.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the account that owns the address: link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username

stateCode.description: US state code of the address, e.g. NJ or CA. Left out: any supported state

isDefaultShipping.description: true when the address must be the user's default shipping address
